findings.title: Single-node topology: one droplet hosts all services and local Redis
findings.note: ARCH-P2-003 / pilot ARCH-P2-001 remain; no HA/warm standby at a62e44a.
evidence: infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml: redis service with local volume
findings.impact: Droplet loss = full outage; Redis data loss window.
findings.recommendation: Define an RTO/RPO and either managed Postgres/Redis or a warm standby.

findings.title: Webhook service used an anonymous Supabase client (fixed)
findings.note: Closed by the 2026-10-03 remediation wave; re-verified at a62e44a.
findings.impact: Previously all webhook DB operations were RLS-denied.

findings.title: Worker health/metrics bind loopback but rely on a shared token
findings.note: Worker /metrics now token-gated; residual is shared-secret hygiene.
findings.recommendation: Rotate the metrics token with the secret-rotation runbook.

report:
Reviewed topology from `infra/terraform`
and `infra/docker/docker-compose.prod.yml`; service clients from
`apps/api/src/lib/supabase.ts`, `socket.ts`, `app.ts`. Confirmed the prior
anonymous-client and unauth-worker-metrics findings are fixed.
